assessment_summary: The statement is false. By Mycielski's construction, one can build triangle-free graphs of arbitrarily large chromatic number. A concrete counterexample is the Mycielskian of the Grötzsch graph (also known as the 5-chromatic Mycielski graph), which has 23 vertices. It is triangle-free but has a chromatic number of 5, which means it is not 4-colourable.
counterexample: The Mycielskian of the Grötzsch graph (the 5-chromatic Mycielski graph).
